issues.claim: https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/ (cited for: order is guaranteed only within a partition; same key goes to the same partition; max.in.flight.requests.per.connection=1 and enable.idempotence protect order within a partition on retries; acks=all means acknowledgement after all in-sync replicas)
issues.problem: The fetched page is only a redirect stub with the title 'Documentation Redirect' and the excerpt 'Redirecting...'. The excerpt supports none of the claims. From my own knowledge the claims are correct: ordering is per partition, the default partitioner hashes the key, idempotence and max.in.flight preserve order within a partition, and acks=all waits for the in-sync replicas. But the cited page cannot be confirmed from the evidence.
issues.suggestedFix: Link the resolved, versioned Kafka documentation page, or a section anchor such as #producerconfigs, and re-fetch it so the excerpt shows the per-partition ordering guarantee and the producer settings. A second link to the producer configuration section for acks, enable.idempotence and max.in.flight would be better.
